Creatures that weren't previously a human and just identified by their job, despite being a human, and then gained that type.

label: keyword counter
description: A collection of all the keyword counters referenced by cards.

label: siege (modal)
description: Named ongoing modal effect. Chosen when entering and tracked by players.

label: delve
description: Exile cards from your graveyard to reduce the cost

label: conjure
description: Create a non-token card out of thin air. One of MTGA's main digital mechanics.

label: functional reminder counter
description: Arbitrarily long effects tracked with a counter, such that removing the counter functionally changes the tracked effect. See also [nonfunctional reminder counter](/tags/card/nonfunctional-reminder-counter).

label: spell with no casting cost
description: Non-land, non-extra cards that have no mana cost (as in, printed on the card).

label: exile with tax
description: Exile something, but let them pay to get it back.

label: restock-instant
description: Effects that put an instant back in your library from the graveyard.

label: passive ability
description: Planeswalkers with non-loyalty abilities.

label: surge
description: Get a benefit if you've cast another spell this turn.

label: unique type line
description: No other card has this same type line. Acorn, playtest, and rebalanced cards may count as unique, but they don't make non-acorn, non-playtest, non-rebalanced cards stop counting as unique.

label: regrowth-sorcery
description: Effects that put a sorcery back in your hand from the graveyard.

label: demilich effect
description: Exiles cards from graveyard, but lets you cast copies of them. Essentially (usually) one-time recursion.

label: castable from exile
description: Cards you can cast or access from exile.

label: burst draw
description: Card draw effects that can net you a bunch of cards at once. As a rule of thumb, to qualify for this tag, the card should let you draw at least three cards at a time and come out ahead by at least +1.

label: synergy-colored
description: Cards that synergize with cards that are any color at all. See also [synergy-color-each](synergy-color-each) and [color count matters](color-count-matters).

label: opponent lifegain
description: Cards that make your opponents gain life.

label: sweeper-one-sided
description: Sweepers that are, or have high potential to be, one-sided.

label: tutor-aura-curse
description: Cards that tutor Curse cards.

label: theft
description: Effects that let you steal cards and resources from your opponent.

label: cycle-abu-dual-land
description: The original dual lands from Alpha/Beta/Unlimited (ABU).

label: living weapon
description: Equipments that attach themselves to a creature they create on ETB.

label: restricted mana
description: Mana that has restrictions on what you can or cannot use it on.

label: deanimate
description: Uncreaturize a creature. For creatures that deanimate themselves, see [deanimate self](deanimate-self).

label: mana ability with extra effect
description: Mana abilities that have some extra effect upon activating them, meaning that they can do actions in strange cases such as during the casting of a split second card and usually can't be prevented in any way.

label: block without creature
description: These cards make something be blocked ... without anything actually doing the blocking.

label: buttstation
description: Cards that station using their toughness rather than their power.

label: cycle-con-esper-scepter
description: Each of these colored artifacts references a famous colorless artifact from Alpha.

label: prevent etb
description: Cards that prevent permanents from entering the battlefield.

label: conjure-permanent
description: Cards that conjure any type of permanent card.

label: balance
description: Effects that attempt to equalize the board state between players by forcing players to sacrifice permanents on the battlefield or discard their cards to a number set by the player with the fewest on the field or in hand.

label: combat trick
description: Effects that can be used during combat to help a creature survive, destroy opposing creatures, or deal additional combat damage.

label: virtual legendary
description: This card represents a one-of-a-kind creature or object (and is named accordingly), and could conceivably have been legendary. Usually cards are in this category because they were printed before legendary existed or have a mechanical need to not be legendary.

label: pitch spell
description: Cards that let you discard or exile another card from your hand to cast for less or no mana

label: flicker-slow
description: Exile a card to be brought back after a set time (usually at end of turn).

label: tutor-creature-flying
description: Cards that tutor creature cards with flying.

label: tutor-artifact-equipment
description: Cards that tutor Equipment cards.

label: creature-ability-noncreature
description: Noncreature, non-Vehicle, non-Spacecraft permanents with abilities that become more relevant when they're animated as creatures, like combat keywords and attack triggers.

label: cycle-lea-circle-protection
description: Cycle that began in Alpha and concluded in Beta

label: misnomer
description: Cards with names that imply something that card isn't, such as a mechanic or a color.

label: deprecated p/t counter
description: In the early days Magic used all kinds of power/toughness modifying counters. Nowadays it just sticks with +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters.

label: tutor-to-top
description: Cards that tutor something and put it on the top of the library.

label: typal-multi-sea-monster
description: Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, Serpent. Sometimes merfolk join in too.

label: dnd item
description: Cards named after and representing DnD items.

label: day/night
description: Effects that make use of or interact with the Day/Night mechanic introduced in Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, including but not limited to cards with the Daybound and Nightbound keywords.

label: paper-compatible
description: Online-only cards that would work if printed in paper, albeit annoying to track or execute at times

label: hate-colored
description: Color hate for cards that are any color at all.

label: inspired
description: Cards that care about the action of untapping a permanent. For cards that care about untapped permanents, see [synergy-untapped](synergy-untapped) and [untapped matters-self](untapped-matters-self).

label: hate-target
description: Cards that make it harder for your opponents to target your stuff or punish them for doing so.

label: mana increaser
description: Cards that increase the mana produced by mana producers, usually lands.

label: counter fuel-pt
description: These cards remove deprecated P/T counters as fuel.

label: tearing
description: Cards which involve physically tearing the card.

label: remove counters-you
description: Remove counters from your permanents or yourself.

label: death trigger
description: Abilities that trigger from permanents being sent to a graveyard. See also [leaves trigger](leaves-battlefield-trigger).

label: tutor-aura-creature
description: Cards that tutor Aura cards with “enchant creature”.

label: fact or fiction
description: Pile/dilemma based card advantage. An opponent is involved in choosing or making the piles.

label: transform-mirror
description: Cards that mirror themselves mechanically when they transform

label: mana leak series
description: Soft counterspells with mana value N that cost more than N to pay off

label: dnd mechanic
description: Cards named after and representing DnD mechanics.

label: synergy-1/1
description: Cards that synergize with creatures that are specifically 1/1.

label: lich effect
description: Effects which turn damage into the loss of cards or permanents. See also [Deal with the devil](/tags/card/deal-with-the-devil)

label: cycle-ust-functional-variant
description: Cards in Unstable that have multiple versions with the same collector number, but different mana cost and/or rules text.

label: cycle-ody-x-of-the-y
description: A vertical cycle of token-producing sorceries with flashback from Odyssey.

label: conditional aura
description: Auras that have a different effect depending on what is being enchanted.

label: creaturefall
description: Cards that care about a creature entering the battlefield. Also known as Alliance in New Capenna.

label: tutor-creature-reach
description: Cards that tutor creature cards with reach.

label: gives player ability
description: Cards that give a player a keyword ability, such as hexproof.

label: set life total
description: Your life total becomes N. See also [life divider](/tags/card/life-divider) and [life doubler](/tags/card/life-doubler).

label: catch-22
description: At the end of turn, if a condition isn't met, a consequence is given.

label: type errata obsolete
description: Cards that had one creature type, that was then made obsolete. Often as a result of the 2007 Grand Creature type update.

label: scooch dice
description: Just nudge the result a little, it's not cheating I promise.

label: consult
description: Dig through your library until you find a card meeting some criteria.

label: sweeper
description: _o\ Destroy all the things! See also [spot removal](spot-removal) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

label: old banish templating
description: Banish effects in which the "exile" and "return" effects are separate linked abilities.

label: precognition engine
description: Cards let you see the top card of your library and conditionally play it. See also [future sight engine](/tags/card/future-sight-engine) for an older variant in this vein.

label: auraify
description: Effects that turn things into auras.

label: more expensive than mv
description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be higher than the card's mana value. See also [cards with X in their mana cost](https://scryfall.com/search?q=m%3Ax).

label: fun ruling
description: Cards with rulings where the rules manager is having fun with us. Not necessarily laugh-out-loud funny.

label: white elephant
description: Permanents that can be given to opponents and have detrimental effects.

label: worship
description: Damage that would reduce your life total to less than N reduces it to N instead.

label: cheaper than mv
description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be lower than the card's mana value.

label: trading post like
description: Cards with activated abilities that feed into their other activated abilities.

label: remove counters
description: Remove counters from stuff.

label: start of game
description: Cards that are particularly effective when you start the game with them.

label: hate-discard
description: Your opponent had better think twice before targeting you with that [Mind Rot](https://tagger.scryfall.com/card/ori/281)!

label: cantrip
description: Cards that let you draw a card as they resolve or enter the battlefield.

label: cycle-dft-team-captain
description: A cycle of legendary creatures featuring the team captains of each team participating in the second edition of the [Ghirapur Grand Prix](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/artwork/ghirapur-grand-prix).

label: hate-low-toughness
description: Cards that punish low toughness in ways beyond just the usual [damaging](burn-creature) or [shrinking](removal-toughness) the creature.

label: repeated keyword
description: Repetition or stacking of a keyword.

label: typal-exclusion
description: "Typal" cards that exclude one or more creature types rather then including a few. Usually to prevent loops, have a specific typal limitation, or to prevent changelings from joining in.

label: tutor-creature-aurochs
description: Cards that tutor Aurochs cards.

label: quick enchant
description: Abilities that attach auras.

label: tutor-land-swamp
description: Cards that tutor Swamp cards.

label: high x matters
description: Cards with X values that do something extra beyond the X effect, as long as X surpasses a specific threshold.

label: copy from graveyard
description: "Brings back" a copy of a permanent card in a graveyard instead of the original. Could be a token copy, could be turning another card into a copy of it.

label: tokenlink
description: Dealing N damage creates N tokens (or similar).

label: mana filter
description: Convert mana to other colors.

label: color break
description: Cards known to break the modern color pie, granting a color access to something it shouldn't be able to do.

label: removal
description: Get things off the table.

label: mutual sacrifice
description: Everyone sacrifices something.

label: wind drake with set's mechanic
description: A 2/2 flyer for 3 with one of the set's iconic mechanics.

label: adds multiple mana
description: Cards that net you more than one mana at a time.

label: pure draw
description: Spells and abilities that let you draw (a) card(s) without discarding other cards or sacrificing other permanents.

label: deprecated card types
description: Cards featuring deprecated card types in some of their prints.

label: lightning bolt redux
description: These cards deal 3 damage for {R} under the right circumstances, like Lightning Bolt.

label: formidable
description: Effects that care if you control creatures with a total power 8 or greater.

label: cycle-cmr-forward-partner
description: The forward half of the draft signpost partner legends in CMR. See also [cycle-cmr-backward-partner](cycle-cmr-backward-partner).

label: counter increaser
description: Cards that increase the amount of counters that would be given to something.

label: hellbending
description: Cards that let you go hellbent, usually by letting you empty your entire hand.

label: noted tracked information
description: Cards that have you note something down in order to track it.

label: karnstructs
description: Cards that make the same construct tokens as Karn, Scion of Urza.

label: copy-token
description: Effects that copy specifically tokens, like populate.

label: life doubler
description: Double someone's life. See also [set life total](/tags/card/set-life-total) and [life divider](/tags/card/life-divider).

label: synergy-graveyard-cast
description: Cards that care about casting spells from graveyards.

label: cycle-plc-tsb-colorshift
description: These cards are colorshifted versions of various cards [reprinted in the Time Spiral Timeshifted set](https://scryfall.com/search?q=s%3Atsb+%28tsh+or+lch+or+gde+or+lso+or+ndb%29&order=color).

label: tapper
description: Tap down permanents. For cards that tap stuff as a cost, see [tap outlet](tap-outlet).

label: pierce
description: Cards whose excess damage is dealt to their target's controller instead.

label: conjure-instant
description: Cards that conjure instants.

label: per-player
description: Effects that scale positively with the number of players; i. e., "for each player", "for each opponent", etc.

label: hate full hand
description: Cards that punish an opponent for having lots of cards in hand.

label: pair-commander
description: These cards can be one half of a two-card pair of commanders

label: chromatic lantern
description: Allows your lands to tap for additional colors of mana. See also [mana filter](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/mana-filter), [land conversion](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/land-conversion).

label: hats matter
description: Cards that care about hats appearing in card art.

label: cunning
description: If X attacks and isn't blocked, you may choose to have it deal damage to another target. If done so, X will deal no combat damage.

label: poison mechanics
description: Cards and effects that interact with poison counters by name.

label: skulk
description: Creatures with power greater than X's power can't block it.

label: functional art
description: Un-Set cards in which their art doubles as a function of the card, usually as a way to track things.

label: four plus creature types
description: Non-Changeling creatures that have four or more creature types

label: counterspell-reusable
description: Counterspell spells and abilities you can use again and again.

label: convoke
description: Cards that let you tap creatures to pay less or no mana for them.

label: keyword errata
description: These cards originally spelled out an ability that became a keyword, and were thus given errata.

label: free-cast-another
description: Cast other things without paying their mana cost.

label: draw hate
description: Cards that can hate on players drawing cards.

label: trigger from graveyard
description: Abilities that trigger from inside the graveyard.

label: alternative crewing
description: Vehicles with crew that also have alternative ways for self-animation. For vehicles without crew see [crewless vehicle](crewless-vehicle).

label: art matters
description: Cards which care about the contents of art. See also [artist matters](/tags/card/artist-matters).

label: restricted attacker
description: Cards that can only attack in specific circumstances.

label: lifegain
description: Cards that cause you to gain life.

label: delayed payment
description: Cards which you can play now, and pay for later

label: regrowth-instant
description: Effects that put an instant back in your hand from the graveyard.

label: fling-self
description: Sacrifice this creature to deal its power in damage. See also [bombard-self](/tags/card/bombard-self), [fling](fling).

label: skip turn
description: Someone skips a turn. See also [prevent extra turns](/tags/card/prevent-extra-turns).

label: conjure-enchantment
description: Cards that conjure enchantments.

label: old typeline
description: Cards that intentionally bring back the old typelines after they were changed for the sake of nostalgia and/or humor. Commonly used for the "Summon" typelines over creatures

label: vertical-cycle
description: Cycles where the cards are in different states of progressions, usually by increasing costs, effects, and/or colors.

label: type errata genericise
description:
Sets of cards that were moved away from their creature type name to a more generic one, to allow them to work in typal decks better.

Cephalids, Naga and Viashino live in our hearts forever.

label: tutor-blue
description: Cards that tutor blue cards.

label: great-designer-search-3
description: Cards that are directly from or seemingly inspired by card designs from The Great Designer Search 3, a competition to find new magic designers.

label: amount spent matters
description: The amount of mana you spent to do the thing matters.

label: named token
description: Tokens that have a specific name, rather than inheriting their name from their type line.

label: combat arbiter
description: Cards that limit how many can attack and/or block in some way.

label: regrowth-creature
description: Return a creature from the graveyard to the hand

label: processing
description: Removes a card of your opponent's from the exile zone for value or to deny them resources.

label: tutor-land-basic-forest
description: Cards that tutor basic Forest land cards.

label: hate-planeswalker
description: Effects that specifically answer or are better against planeswalkers. This does not include effects that happen to trigger whether it's a player or planeswalker and don't help remove the planeswalker.

label: super-pridemate
description: Put +1/+1 counters equal to the amount of life gained.

label: gating
description: When this comes into play, return a permanent that shares a colour with it to your hand.

label: virtual french vanilla
description: Creatures and vehicles that are french vanilla (having only keyword abilities) after entering the battlefield. They may have "enters the battlefield" or "on cast" trigger.

label: cycle-bro-mishra-vertical
description: Mishra in Uncommon, Rare and Mythic Meld from Brothers War

label: tutor-creature-merfolk
description: Cards that tutor Merfolk cards.

label: planeswalker deck staples
description: Cards that are formulaic includes of planeswalker decks: [tutors](/tags/card/pwdeck-tutor) to help you find the deck's planeswalker, and [sidekicks](/tags/card/pwdeck-sidekick) that benefit from having that planeswalker out.

label: titan trigger
description: An ability that triggers on both entering the battlefield and attacking, similar to the Titan cycle from M11

label: tutor-to-exile
description: Cards that tutor into exile for later use.

label: rampage
description: A creature gets +N/+N for each creature blocking it

label: graveyard fuel
description: Cards that require exiling other cards in graveyard as a cost for abilities and effects.

label: hate-high-mv
description: Cards that specifically hate on cards with high mana value, typically at least 3 or 4.

label: impulsive curiosity
description: Exile your cards when a creature deals damage to an opponent, and you can play them for a limited duration.

label: combat ramp
description: Generate mana/more lands by attacking and/or dealing combat damage

label: tutor-land-any
description: Tutors with restricted effects that are able to search for any land.

label: tutor-host
description: Cards that tutor host cards.

label: harmonic
description: Cards that care about artifacts and enchantments separately.

label: mana rock
description: Noncreature artifacts that net increase your mana.

label: burn bright with set mechanic
description: Cards like [Burn Bright](https://scryfall.com/card/rna/93/burn-bright) or [Trumpet Blast](https://scryfall.com/card/m10/160/trumpet-blast), but with the set's mechanic.

label: tutor-to-graveyard
description: Tutor cards into your graveyard.

label: untapper
description: Cards that can untap things.

label: repeatable pure draw
description: Repeatable ways to draw a card with no additional cost or sacrifice, such as discarding a card

label: legendary team-up
description: March of the Machines introduced a number of cards representing legendary cards teaming up. (And some playtest cards expanded on the concept.)

label: reanimate
description: Return permanent cards from the graveyard to the battlefield.

label: drain strength
description: One thing gets bigger, another gets smaller. See also [persecution effect](persecution-effect).

label: recursion from exile
description: Brings itself or other cards you own back from exile, regardless of what effect might have put them there. For effects that do this to your opponent's cards, see [processing](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/processing).

label: cycle-kld-module
description: The Modules of Kaladesh were designed to work together in this order: Animation -> Decoction -> Fabrication -> repeat.

label: bushido
description: Whenever X blocks or becomes blocked, its power and toughness is modified until end of turn.

label: life-and-death-trigger-self
description: Permanents that have an effect that triggers when they enter the battlefield and when they die. See also [enters-and-leaves triggers](enters-and-leaves-trigger-self).

label: french vanilla
description: These creatures, vehicles and spacecraft have only keyword abilities.

label: nonfunctional reminder counter
description: Effects that last forever tracked with a nonfunctional reminder counter, such that removing the counter makes no functional change to the tracked effect. See also [functional reminder counter](/tags/card/functional-reminder-counter).

label: gives poisonous
description: Gives a creature the ability to give a set amount of poison counters to opponents upon combat damage, like the poisonous keyword

label: tutor-flashback
description: Cards that tutor cards with flashback.

label: repeatable draw
description: Draw cards repeatedly, no matter if you go up on cards or not.

label: noncreature french vanilla
description: These noncreature, nonvehicle, nonspacecraft cards have only keyword abilities. (For vehicles and spacecraft, see [french vanilla](french-vanilla).)

label: reanimate-from-opponent
description: Cards that specifically have the ability to reanimate cards opponents have, if not any card

label: forced attacker
description: Creatures that have to attack every combat if possible.

label: etb-untapper
description: Cards that make things enter the battlefield untapped.

label: cycle-zendikar-creatureland
description: The supercycle of dual creaturelands, begun in Worldwake and completed in Battle for Zendikar.

label: token doubler
description: If you would make X tokens, twice are made instead.

label: bear with set's mechanic
description: A 2/2 for 2 with one of the set's iconic mechanics

label: cycle-rav-shockland
description: The original cycle of shocklands from Ravnica block.

label: naya ferocious
description: Cards that care about you controlling creatures with power 5 or greater.

label: donate token
description: Effects that can create tokens under an opponents control.

label: synergy-artifact
description: You might also be interested in [synergy-equipment](synergy-equipment) and [synergy-artifact-creature](synergy-artifact-creature).

label: synergy-monocolor
description: Cards that care about things being a single color.

label: synergy-vanilla
description: Synergizes with creatures that have no abilities.

label: your sacrifice matters
description: Effects that reward you for sacrificing your own permanents. Contrast [opponent sacrifice matters](opponent-sacrifice-matters).

label: outnumber
description: Deal damage to a creature based on your creature count.

label: unique keyword
description: This card uses a keyword action, ability, or variant thereof that's found on no other cards.

label: state trigger
description: Cards that use a state trigger, which is a particular and rare kind of trigger. A common one is "When you control no [X]s, sacrifice this creature".

label: phyrexian mana ability
description: Cards whose activated abilities cost phyrexian mana

label: mana restriction
description: Spells with unusual restrictions on how they can be paid for.

label: pseudo-leveler
description: Creatures with abilities that add incremental layers of growth.

label: old fight
description: Before Fight was keyworded in Innistrad, it was a one-then-the-other procedure spelled out in oracle text.

label: metalcraft
description: Effects when the player controls three or more artifacts.

label: transcendental life/damage
description: Damage or life expressed in transcendental numbers. (Yes, we know this means it's not actually fractional.)

label: tutor-creature-rat
description: Cards that tutor Rat cards.

label: alternative cost
description: Spells with alternative casting costs, which may be cheaper or more expensive than their mana costs. See CR 118.9.

label: cycle-land
description: All the land cycles. See in particular: [monocolor land cycles](/tags/card/cycle-mono-land), [dual land cycles](/tags/card/cycle-dual-land), and [triland cycles](/tags/card/cycle-triland).

label: pseudo-exert
description: Cards that mimic the exert mechanic by preventing themselves from untapping for some effect.

label: forced opponent shuffle
description: Effects that can force an opponent to shuffle their library.

label: type errata specific
description: Cards that had a very specific type line that was simplified to a larger group.

label: cycle-con-forward-synergy
description: Way looser than the backward cycle, I'd say these don't qualify given that there isn't even a green->white card.

label: banish-hand
description: Exile one or more cards from a player's hand as long as this remains in play.

label: card names
description: A collection of tags identifying properties and naming schemes in cards.

label: repeatable crime
description: Repeatable ways to commit crimes by targeting an opponent or something they control.

label: preexisting dnd background
description: Cards named after Dungeons & Dragons backgrounds that already exist! 🎲

label: cycle-gpt-nephilim
description: The five Nephilim that awoke during Guildpact.

label: seek-artifact
description: Seek for artifact cards.

label: type errata hound
description: These were all hounds, now thanks to Ruff they're all dogs, as of Core set 2021 (Or in the case of Jackal Pup, a Jackal)

label: graveyard order matters
description: These cards care about the order of cards in a graveyard, or rearrange them somehow. If any of these cards are in a player's deck, care must be taken to preserve the order of the graveyard.

label: quick attach
description: Abilities that instantly attach equipment and/or auras.

label: threaten
description: Gain control of a permanent until end of turn. For continuous theft see [theft-creature](/tags/card/theft-creature).

label: dnd
description: Cards made to reference mechanical parts of the Dungeons and Dragons TTRPG.

label: disenchant/naturalize
description: Cards that remove artifacts and/or enchantments.

label: stalking
description: The "can't be blocked by more than one creature" ability, [as named by the designers](http://markrosewater.tumblr.com/post/178266363158). See also [gives stalking](gives-stalking).

label: shardland
description: Lands that produce mana from a "shard" (three allied colours).

description: The top card of your library matters for purposes other than playing it or drawing it.

description: Cards that make you roll dice. For things that like or help when you roll dice, see [Synergy Dice](synergy-dice)

description: Cards that tutor Gate cards.

description: Cards with a certain name can't be cast. See also [lobotomy](/tags/card/lobotomy), where certain cards can't be exist.

description: Draw two cards, then discard a card.

description: New ways for you to lose the game

description: A vertical cycle of creatures from Odyssey that reduce your hand size.

label: mana producer
description: Nonland cards that generate mana.

label: scales with damage dealt
description: Effects that scale with how much damage a creature deals.

label: gives vigilance
description: See also [untapper-creature](untapper-creature).

label: pacifism
description: A form of removal that prevents a creature from attacking, and usually also from blocking and/or activating its abilities.

label: perpetual aura
description: Auras that come back to your hand as they "fall off".

label: super-menace
description: Because you can get more menacing than menace.

label: gives high flying
description: These cards give other creatures [high flying](high-flying).

label: hate-etb
description: Disrupts enters-the-battlefield triggers

label: type errata summon creature
description: These creatures typelines at some point just read "Summon Creature", thanks to Portal!

label: grafted skullcap
description: Draw extra cards every turn, but discard your hand at the end of your turn.

description: Exile a spell on the stack, and bring it back when this permanent goes away.

description: The Urza's Legacy monocolored creaturelands

label: conjure-nonland
description: Cards that conjure nonland cards.

label: cycle-bro-urza-vertical
description: Urza in Uncommon, Rare and Mythic Meld from Brothers War

description: Rakshasa used to be Cat Demons or Cat Devils, but they have now lost the Cat type

description: Cards with abilities that create multiple creature tokens when a creature dies.

description: Some creatures get +N/+N, while other creatures get -N/-N

description: Hate on colorless cards. See also [hate-color](/tags/card/hate-color) for color hate.

description: Cards that tutor Desert cards.

description: Permanents with abilities that trigger when they die.

description: Get hit and lose a sizeable fraction of your life.

description: Cards that tutor Rebel cards.

description: These cards had the deprecated mana source type during some of their prints.

description: Cards with a function of "draw N cards, then discard 2 unless you discard [type]"

description: Cards that tutor colorless creature cards.

description: Collection tag for the Ward keyword. Should be 1:1 with kw:ward.

label: external prop
description: Cards that involve external props, whether objects or body parts, other than the standard tokens.

label: tongue twister
description: Try saying any of these card names three times fast!

description: Cards that have little to no use in formats that are Singleton (allowing only one of most cards save for basic lands) such as commander

description: Spells that deal damage to creatures with flying. See [earthquake](earthquake) for the inverse effect.

label: half mana
description: Cards that add or use one-half mana from Unhinged.

label: charm
description: Modal spells where you pick one option out of three

label: rainbow land
description: A land that can net one or more mana of any color.

label: tapland
description: Non-basic lands which come into play tapped

label: remove counters-player
description: Remove counters from players.

description: Allows you to play other cards from the graveyard.

label: modal inverse choices
description: Spells where the modal options are: X, Mirror of X

label: alternate win condition
description: New ways for you to win the game (or cause your opponent to lose)

description: These are cards that have only one known printing of them, as a one-off celebration card. This tag isn't for specific one-off printings, only mechanically unique cards.

label: red effect
description: Effects which are iconically red.

label: support
description: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures.

label: peek-library
description: Look at some number of cards from the top of libraries

label: single-minded graveyard hate
description: These cards do nothing except prevent your opponent from accessing the cards in their graveyard; you can expect them to be completely useless if they aren't playing any form of graveyard interaction.

label: dnd book
description: Cards that are named after an actual printed Dungeons and Dragons book or adventure module.

label: intervening if clause
description: At/When/Whenever [event], if [clause], [effect].

description: Spells that counter stuff. See child tags for variants on the behaviour; notably [counterspell-soft](/tags/card/counterspell-soft) which gives the opponent a buyout cost.

label: polymorph
description: Effects that remove a permanent and replace it with another random one.

label: brainstorm
description: Draw a number of cards, then put cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

label: platinum angel effect
description: Cards that stop you specifically from losing while preventing your opponents from winning.

label: painland
description: Lands that deal damage to the user upon tapping them for mana. For the original cycle of painlands, see [cycle-painland](cycle-painland) or [is:painland](https://scryfall.com/search?q=is%3Apainland).

label: tutor-creature-minotaur
description: Cards that tutor Minotaur creature cards.

label: gives stalking
description: Cards that make creatures only be blockable by no more than one creature, also known as "[stalking](stalking)".

label: cycle-cycling-land
description: Cycles of cycling lands. (Alternate title: we saw you like cycles, so we put cycling in your cycles so you can cycle while you cycle.)

label: leaves graveyard trigger
description: Cards that have triggers whenever a card (or cards) leave your graveyard

label: reminder card
description: Cards that remind you of your game state.

label: tutor-creature-dwarf
description: Cards that tutor Dwarf cards.

label: cards in exile matter
description: Mechanics that care about the cards in Exile.

label: uril ability
description: An ability in which the P/T of one or more creatures can increase based on the number of aura attached to one creature outside of the aura's effects of being attached. See also [ethereal armor](ethereal-armor).

label: vanilla equipment
description: Equipment that only changes power and toughness.

label: shrink
description: Nerf a creature's power, temporarily or otherwise. Not to be confused with [humble](humble).

label: affinity for land type
description: Affinity abilities that care about land types.

label: swap removal
description: Sorry I messed up your stuff. Here's a thing in exchange. (See also [humble](/tags/card/humble).)

label: booster tutor
description: Cards, usually acorn cards, that have you open booster packs to add into the game.

label: mutiny
description: Cards that can make multiple creatures under the same players control fight (or [bite](one-sided-fight))

label: reveal hand
description: Makes players reveal their hands more permanently than [peek](peek-hand)

label: emerge
description: Creatures that let you sacrifice something to cast them at a cost reduced by the mana cost of the creature sacrificed

label: single-minded typal hate
description: Cards that hate on a specific creature type (or types), and do nothing else if creatures of that type aren't present.

label: cycle-shm-hideaway-creature
description: These creatures are the ones hidden inside the hideaway lands.

label: counterspell-sorcery
description: Counterspells that call out sorceries specifically.

label: cycle-ice-two-color-enemy-hate
description: These allied enchantments hose their common enemy color, either directly or indirectly.

label: gives evasion
description: Cards that make a creature harder or impossible to block.

label: leaves battlefield trigger
description: Cards that trigger on something leaving the battlefield. See also [death trigger](death-trigger).

label: cycle-tr-mage
description: A multi-set "mega cycle" of wizards that tutor for an artifact card of a specific mana value, with their card name starting with "Tr-"

label: protects-all
description: Effects that give a form of protection to all permanents of a kind. (That may be hexproof, indestructible, protection, etc.)

label: wheel
description: Discard your hand, draw back up.

label: undergrowth-all
description: Cards that care about the amount of creatures card in all graveyards.

label: pile
description: Effects that make you put things in a pile for selection/grouping purposes

label: tapper-planeswalker
description: Tap effects don't normally work on planeswalkers because planeswalkers don't normally care about being tapped. These cards are the exception: they can tap a planeswalker AND they have a little extra text to make it actually matter that you tapped it.

label: protection
description: Effects relating to protecting your permanents (not necessarily via the protection keyword.)

label: clone assassin
description: Clones that remove the thing they cloned, either immediately, or later.

label: cycle-unspeakable
description: When cast in sequence, the three instants in question let their controller search their library for The Unspeakable and put it directly into play.

label: unique creature type
description: Creatures with one or more single creature types that are unique to them, not counting creature types on tokens.

label: mill-exile
description: Exile cards from the top of a library.

label: reanimate-self
description: These cards can return themselves to the battlefield if they're sitting in the graveyard. Not to be confused with [cheat death-self](cheat-death-self), where the card returns immediately after dying.

label: donate
description: Effects that give control of another card you control to another player

label: manaless land
description: The vast majority of lands in the game can either tap for mana or be exchanged for another land that does. This tag represents the rare exceptions to that rule.

label: keyword soup
description: These cards list out all or almost all the keyword abilities found in their set, possibly restricted by color.

label: specter ability
description: Damaging the opponent strips cards out of their hand.

label: tutor-creature-mercenary
description: Cards that tutor Mercenary cards.

label: seek-to-battlefield
description: Seek a card onto the battlefield.

label: no-creature-type
description: Creatures without any creature types

label: howlgeist ability
description: Creatures with lesser power can't block these creatures.

label: eldrazi titan
description: The various Eldrazi Titan trios.

label: type errata cephalid
description: These were Cephalids, now Octopuses as of Modern Horizons 3.

label: enchantment engine
description: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, draw a card.

label: doom blade
description: 2 MV "Destroy target creature, unless it's X"

label: graveyard seal
description: Prevent interaction with the graveyard or reanimation, or make it more difficult.

label: madness
description: The specific keyword, madness (Used for applying specific subtags)

description: These cards were originally printed with the Legend creature type. Their type line read “Summon Legend” or “Creature — Legend”.

label: buttstrike
description: Creatures assign damage equal to their toughness.

label: life-total-matters-self
description: Cards that care about your life total being above or below a certain amount. This doesn’t include cards like Phyrexian Arena that simply want you to be alive.

label: cast on resolution
description: Spells and abilities that let you cast spells as part of their resolution.

label: egg
description: Artifacts that have to be sacrificed to do something.

label: typal coupling
description: Cards that care about two or more different creature types.

label: typal-goblin-orc
description: Green, mean, and ready to hit you in the spleen. In Lord of the Rings, often seen alongside Army.

label: hunger trigger
description: Abilities that trigger off other creatures dying to this one. Named after the more-specific Hunger ability.

label: consult-cast
description: Consult effects that let you cast the card you find.

label: references keyword
description: Cards that call back to a keyword or mechanic from an older set. It's like the "References/Referenced By" relationship, but for a mechanic instead of an individual card.

label: unstable secret base
description: There are five Secret Base cards in Unstable. They share the same collector number but have different art, flavor text and watermark, matching each of the five Bablovian factions.

label: rummage to library
description: Rummage with the discarded cards tucked in your library.

label: cycle-lea-red-escalate
description: An early vertical cycle, three red creatures with the same P/T and mana cost, but with escalating abilities as rarity increases.

label: the doctor
description: Cards that represent The Doctor, the eponymous lead of Doctor Who.

label: turn control
description: Cards that make one player control another player's turn, either for the entire turn or for specific times during that turn.

label: grim return
description: Get stuff that just went away back on the battlefield. Compare [cheat death](cheat-death), which often overlaps.

label: fling
description: Sacrifice a creature to deal its power in damage to something. See also [bombard](/tags/card/bombard), [one-sided fight](/tags/card/one-sided-fight), [fling-self](fling-self).

label: restock-all
description: Cards that put your entire graveyard into your library

label: tutor-red
description: Cards that tutor red cards.

label: tutor-enchantment
description: Cards that tutor enchantment cards.

description: Create a triggered ability that may trigger later. Similar to a [reflexive trigger](reflexive-trigger).

label: draft matters
description: Cards that care about their use in limited formats in some way

label: tuck
description: Effects that put a spell or permanent into its owner's library.

description: Give a creature +X/+0 until end of turn via an activated ability.

label: gifts ungiven
description: Get X cards from a location, opponent picks an amount of those you get to keep.

label: aikido
description: Effects that turn your opponent's strength against them.

label: counterspell-sweeper
description: Counter ALL the things!

label: transform-improvement
description: Cards that do the same effect but better, or the same effects but with extra when they transform.

label: cycle-sunscape-vertical
description: White cycle of an Apprentice and Master from Invasion and a Familiar and Battlemage from Planeshift.

label: onomatopoeia
description: Boom! Crash! Kapow!

label: impulsive draw
description: Cards which let you cast a card for a limited time off the top of a library (via exile). Use it or lose it. Typically a red card advantage mechanic. See also [impulsive mill](impulsive-mill). For the effect seen on the [card Impulse](/card/vis/34), see the [tag impulse](impulse).

label: landhome
description: An old two-part mechanic: you had to control a land of a certain type to keep this creature on the battlefield, and the opponent needed to control a land of the same type to be attacked by it. It often got used in just one of the halves, so we tag either half.

label: deprecated untapped artifact
description: Until 6th edition, artifacts were deactivated when they were tapped. These cards from prior to 6ed have that behaviour baked into their current rules text.

label: offcolor additional cost
description: Cards with an additional cost of mana beyond the card's own colors.

label: token versions of cards
description: Some cards create tokens identical to existing cards (except for CMC). See: [cards creating these tokens](/tags/card/creates-token-of-a-card),  [printed tokens](/tags/card/token-version-of-a-card), and [the cards recreated in token form](/tags/card/has-identical-token).

label: free discard outlet
description: Ways to discard repeatedly that require no additional cost or numerical limit.

label: typal-sneaky
description: Ninjas and rogues, with their powers combined

label: draft signpost
description: Cards that represent a draft archetype in a given set. Typically designed as ten two-color uncommons (2CUDS).

label: potentially black border
description: Cards not intended for constructed play that could have been printed in a vintage/commander legal product instead if they were printed today.

label: dnd character
description: Cards that represent Dungeons and Dragons characters: name, rules text, etc. See also the [dungeons and dragons](/tags/artwork/dungeons-and-dragons) art tag.

label: bounceland
description: Non-basic lands which tap for two mana, but require you to return a land to your hand when you play them.

label: graveyard fuel-creature
description: Exiles creatures from the graveyard for value

description: Hate cards that do absolutely nothing at all if you're not in the right matchup.

label: explore-like
description: Look at the top card, then you may draw it. If you don't, you may put it away.

label: alternate-cost-gain-life
description: Cards that let you give your opponents life to play them for less or no mana

label: cards in graveyard matter
description: Mechanics that care about the cards in one or more graveyards.

label: tutor-green
description: Cards that tutor green cards.

label: energy increaser
description: Cards that increase the amount of energy you get.

label: cycle-znr-multiclass-creature
description: A vertical cycle of creatures that were every Party mechanic class.

label: cycle-tor-black-dreams
description: A vertical cycle of black Dreams cards from Torment.

description: Cards designed by players who won Invitationals. The original print traditionally features the winning player. See also [Player Spotlight](player-spotlight).

label: protects-creature
description: Effects that can protect a creature, e.g. with protection,  hexproof, indestructible, etc.

description: Tap something to buff a creature; if that creature leaves play, destroy whatever buffed it. Was also used as an early way to represent vehicles/mounts.

description: Derived from the titular card, this refers to the effect in which lands lose their land type and/or abilities, being replaced by something else.

description: Mana that can't be spent to cast nonartifact spells.

label: curiosity
description: Draw cards when dealing damage to an opponent

description: Cards that give you mana equal to or greater than the amount of mana spent for it, either in the form of a immediately usable mana ability, a ritual effect, or untapped lands

label: clone graveyard
description: Cards that enter as a copy of another card, but sourced from the graveyard rather than the battlefield.

label: shade pump
description: Effects that give an arbitrary amount of +1/+1 until end of turn. See also [firebreathing](firebeathing) in red and [armoring](armoring) in white.

label: neo-regenerate
description: An activated ability that says "this gains indestructible; tap it" is the new Regenerate.

label: cycle-fut-spellshaper
description: Cycle of creatures that make a token copy of an existing creature (Or yet to exist creature, in the case of Goldmeadow Lookout)

label: conjure-to-hand
description: Cards that conjure cards to your hand.

label: shapechange
description: Set creatures' power/toughness, not necessarily a nerf. See also [humble](/tags/card/humble).

label: protects-self
description: Permanents with keywords or abilities that protect them from being interacted with on board.

label: sift
description: Draw three cards, then discard a card. Not to be confused with [compulsive research](compulsive-research) or [probe](probe).

label: discarded type matters
description: The type of card you discard matters for some effect.

label: cycle-ody-wincon-enchantment
description: The cycle of five alternate win condition enchantments from Odyssey block.

description: Fog effects where the damage prevention is or has the potential to be asymmetrical in some way, usually by exempting a subset of attackers/defenders.

label: gives castable from nonhand
description: Allows you to play other cards from zones other than your hand.

label: type errata lord
description: These cards used to have the now defunct "Lord" type

label: cycle-tor-red-punisher
description: A vertical cycle of red punisher cards from Torment.

label: named choice
description: Players choose something, but the choices are given names, rather than choosing the effect itself.

label: conjure-artifact
description: Cards that conjure artifacts.

label: sacrifice self
description: Permanents that have abilities that make them sacrifice themselves.

label: chain spell
description: Spells that let their victims copy them, effectively chaining around the table until someone doesn't/can't.

label: scales with power
description: Effects which scale with the power of one or more creatures.

label: filterland
description: Lands that take one mana and give you back another colour of mana, sometimes in greater quantities.

label: tutor-creature-wizard
description: Cards that tutor Wizard cards.

label: lhurgoyf
description: Cards with power and/or toughness equal to number of cards in the graveyard, or a similar variant. This term is referenced from the Mechanical Color Pie 2017 article by Mark Rosewater. See also [maro](maro) and [warlord](warlord).

label: tutor-creature-faerie
description: Cards that tutor Faerie cards.

label: hate-color
description: Color hate for one or more colors. See also [hate-colorless](/tags/card/hate-colorless).

label: peek-hand
description: Take a quick look at a players hand

label: cycle-mmq-cateran-recruiter
description: A double vertical cycle of six Mercenaires from Mercadian Masques. Each one has the Mercenary recruiting ability  with converted mana costs from 1 to 6.

label: mulch
description: An effect that filters cards at the top of the library, putting remainders into the graveyard.

label: mill
description: A keyword action used in Magic to describe the action of a player taking cards from the top of their library and putting them into their graveyard.

label: recursion
description: Get stuff back from your graveyard to use it again. See: reanimate (to battlefield), regrowth (to hand), and restock (to library).

label: illusion ability
description: Permanents that sacrifice themselves if they get targeted by anything

label: utility mana rock
description: Mana rocks that do extra things.

label: refund
description: Immediately get mana or untapped lands back.

label: pridemate
description: Effects that put +1/+1 counters on something when you gain life.

label: synergy-color-every
description: Cards that want all five colors to be present. See also [synergy-color-each](synergy-color-each) for effects that still scale up based on the number of colors, but don't necessarily need you to have all five.

label: unique p/t
description: Cards with a power/toughness not seen on any other card.

label: conjure-card
description: Cards that conjure cards of unknown type or of any type of card.

label: selective group hug
description: Group Hug cards that benefit only certain opponents in particular.

label: supercycle-mmmm-enrager
description: A supercycle of Horrors costing MMMM, each retaliating to damage in its own way.

label: mana egg
description: Mana rocks that have to be sacrificed to add mana. They may ramp or merely filter your mana.

label: discard to exile
description: Put cards from the opponent's hand into exile, either permanently or by [banishing](banish-hand) them.

label: zoo
description: Cards that create multiple tokens of different types.

label: delayed cantrip
description: Draw a card next turn.

label: mana cost matters
description: Cards that care about the actual symbols in a mana cost.

label: toughness matters
description: Other than in, you know, the usual way.

description: Cards that care about the card types of other cards that they've exiled with a linked ability.

label: tutor-to
description: Tutor to specific zones.

label: cycle-rix-immortal-sun-purpose
description: A cycle of cards from Rivals of Ixalan that had flavor text representing the Immortal Sun's importance to each of the factions.

label: card style matters
description: Foiling, alt art, etc matters.

description: Cards that give themselves or other creatures keyword abilities if something else has it. See also [keyword soup](keyword-soup).

label: clone
description: Cards that enter as copies of other things

label: cycle-m20-doubles
description: Five cards with alliterative names and a theme of doing something twice.

description: Equipment with non-standard equip costs (e.g. equip restriction, sacrifice stuff, etc.)

description: Effects that allow you to put additional lands from your hand, top of the library, or graveyard onto the battlefield outside of your normal once-per-turn land play. For effects that let you search your library for cards, refer to [tutor land](/tags/card/tutor-land).

description: Cards that care about the card types of cards in a graveyard.

description: Bring back a card of any card type from your graveyard to your hand.

label: saboteur
description: Effects that trigger when you deal damage to an opponent.

label: tutor-mv
description: Cards that tutor cards with a certain mana value.

label: auto equip
description: Equipments that attach themselves to other creatures as they enter the battlefield.

label: staple with set's mechanic
description: A common card design that is related to one or more of the main mechanics in a set

label: type errata addition
description: Cards that received a new type because it fit them, or because they were lacking one before.

label: recurring suspend
description: Cards that have suspend and, upon resolving, suspend themselves once more.

label: cycle-infinity-stone
description: The super cycle of Infinity Stones

label: soothsaying
description: Look at the top N cards of a library and rearrange them.

label: impulsive mill
description: Like [impulsive draw](impulsive-draw), but using the graveyard as a holding zone instead of exile.

label: copy
description: Effects that copy things

label: name matters
description: Effects that care about card names: different names, same name, specific name, etc.

label: cycle-fdn-r-two-color
description: Two-color rares from Foundations found in Play Boosters.

label: disturb
description: Compilation tag for the Disturb keyword. Should be 1:1 with "kw:disturb".

label: lifegain to damage
description: Transforms player lifegain into player damage.

label: keyword errata surveil
description: Cards that Surveil but were either printed before the keyword was made, or before it was made deciduous in The Brothers' War

label: fateseal
description: The ability to 'scry' another player's library instead of your own. Variants of this ability may allow you to choose between your own library and that of another player.

label: repeatable card advantage
description: Things that give you access to more cards, repeatably.

label: unstable variant
description: Cards in Unstable that have multiple versions with the same collector number.

label: mass shrink
description: Shrink your opponent's whole board (or part of it).

label: circle of protection
description: Enchantments with activated abilities that prevent damage from a chosen source.

label: krarks other thumb effect
description: If you'd roll a die, instead roll that many plus extra, then pick/get the best results.

label: pillage effect
description: Cards that loot/rummage and create Treasure(s).

label: dexterity
description: Cards that require physical interaction outside of normal game scope, such as tossing cards or specific usage of one's head or hands. This can be an accessibility issue for some who have limited mobility, so it's now only used as an un-set mechanic.

label: tutor-land-basic-island
description: Cards that tutor basic Island land cards.

label: player spotlight
description: Player Spotlight cards are Magic: The Gathering cards that celebrate the winners of the World Championships, similar to [Invitational Cards](invitational-card) that were made in the years 1997–2007.

label: land ramp
description: Ramp spells that net you more lands on your side of the battlefield.

label: aesthetic counter
description: Counters that have no rules meaning, just aesthetic.

label: drawlink
description: Effects that cause combat damage dealt to draw that many cards.

label: man-o'-war
description: Creatures that can bounce your opponent's stuff when they enter the battlefield.

label: non-mana ward
description: Ward abilities with non-mana payments.

label: curiosity-like
description: Cards that can give you some form of card advantage upon dealing damage, usually combat damage, to a player.

label: vanilla aura
description: Auras that only change power and toughness.

label: typal-non-borg
description: Also known as the "Federation" mechanic in TRK.

label: counter fuel
description: Remove counters to do something.

label: affinity for spells
description: Costs 1 less to cast for each instant or sorcery card in your graveyard

label: scales with multiple
description: Cards that scale as you play more copies of themselves.

label: attacking matters-any
description: Cards that care about anyone attacking.

label: out of color token
description: Cards which create tokens which are one or more colours the original card isn't.

label: tutor-creature-pirate
description: Cards that tutor Pirate cards.

label: change name
description: Cards that change the name of themselves or other cards.

label: sword of x and y
description: Originally a slow cycle of swords that give an protection from an enemy coloured pairing and additional bonuses based on those colors, now an enduring archetype of magic.

label: miniwheel
description: Discard your hand, and draw less than seven cards. See also [wheel](/tags/card/wheel) for drawing (potentially) seven or more cards.

label: high flying
description: Flying creatures that can only block other flying creatures. See also [gives high flying](gives-high-flying).

label: tutor-land-specific
description: Cards that search for one specific land

description: Effects that can protect you from an entire combat phase, similar to the card Fog, but using less conventional means than damage prevention.

description: Cards that tutor Mountain cards.
