description: Search for a card, and then discard a card at random (with a chance to discard the card you tutored for)

label: trigger from exile
description: Abilities that trigger from inside exile.

label: crew
description: Compilation tag for the Crew keyword. Should be 1:1 with [kw:crew](https://scryfall.com/search?q=kw%3Acrew).

label: type errata dinosaur
description: These creatures that were obviously dinosaurs the whole time, gained or changed to a Dinosaur typeline with the release of Ixalan.

label: exponential
description: Effects that involve some amount of exponential growth. This can be an exponential value, or a token creation effect that would be exponential if allowed to progress unhindered. See [quadratic](quadratic) for a different, but similar kind of effect.

label: cast trigger-you
description: Whenever you cast X, do something.

label: seek-card
description: Seek for a card of any type.

label: tutor-creature-dragon
description: Cards that tutor Dragon creature cards.

label: firebend-like
description: When a creature attacks, get mana of some kind

label: modal
description: Spells which give you your choice from two or more distinct functions.

label: loner
description: Cards that want you to have only one creature, or creatures that want to be the only creature a player controls

label: class type only
description: These creatures have only a class type, and no type correlating to whatever fantasy race they might belong to.

label: hand disruption
description: Mess with your opponent's hand.

label: substance
description: Substance is an obsolete static ability that has no effect at all. It existed briefly only as a technical detail to support implementing a few cards in Magic Online's Mirage release.

label: impulsive freecast
description: Exile cards from your library and cast them for free for a limited duration.

label: conjure-to-battlefield
description: Cards that conjure other cards onto the battlefield.

label: offcolor ability
description: Abilities with a mana cost outside the card's colors.

label: old lifelink
description: Before lifelink was keyworded in Magic 2010, it was a triggered ability.

label: dnd spell
description: Cards originally from DnD sets that are named after and representing DnD spells.

label: tutor-creature-goblin
description: Cards that tutor Goblin cards.

label: gainland
description: Lands that have you gain life when they enter the battlefield.

label: creates bigger body
aliases: say hello to my little friend
description: Creature cards that generate additional creatures beefier than themselves. (Typically this means having a higher total power and toughness than the original creature.)

label: ball lightning
description: A high-damage one-turn creature.

label: pariah
description: Cards that redirect damage to themselves (Or to the unfortunate equipped/enchanted creature)

label: multi removal
description: Removal for more than one, but less than all.  See also [spot removal](spot-removal) and [sweeper](sweeper).

label: potentially free
description: Cards that can be played without spending any resources (Mana, life, tapping creatures, etc). Cards must be able to be not free, to be potentially free.

label: block trigger
description: Effects that trigger on a creature blocking or becoming blocked.

label: meme
description: Cards that have become memes in Magic, or are explicitly based off of memes.

label: mini refund
description: Immediately gives you a small amount of mana or untapped lands back (typically no more than about one-third of the mana cost you paid)

label: magic term name
description: Card names that are specifically terms used by Wizards of the Coast or fans of Magic: The Gathering

label: maro-sorcerer
description: Creatures that scale in power and toughness with the number of lands you control.

label: loot to library
description: Draw, then shuffle cards into your library or put them on the bottom of it. Contrast [brainstorm](brainstorm).

label: tutor-augment
description: Cards that tutor cards with augment.

label: repeatable pp counters
description: Repeatable ways of putting +1/+1 counters on creatures.

label: death trigger opponent
description: Cards that trigger when an opponent's permanent is sent to a graveyard.

label: ditch hand
description: Cards that let you get rid of your current hand in some way or other.

label: enchantmentfall
description: Cards that care about enchantments entering the batllefield.

label: legendfall
description: Cards that care about legendaries entering the battlefield.

label: young pyromancer ability
description: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a creature token.

label: roman numeral
description: Cards with a roman numeral in the name.

label: conjure-artifact-creature
description: Cards that conjure artifact creatures.

label: fractional power/toughness
description: Cards that have ½ power/toughness, or grant it

label: ninjutsu
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Ninjutsu. Should be 1-1 with kw:ninjutsu.

label: conjure-battle
description: Cards that conjure battles.

label: haven
description: Exile your permanents to return them at much later point, essentially storing them somewhere safe. Not to be confused with [flicker](/tags/card/flicker) or [banish](banish).

label: eternalize
description: Make 4/4 copies of creatures in graveyards.

label: no mercy
description: Cards that destroy creatures that damage you.

label: group slug
description: Cards that are able to deal damage or otherwise target multiple players at once.

label: scry
description: See also [scry-like](scry-like) for effects that are like scry, but don't use the keyword.

label: nimble
description: "Can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater", an opposite of [daunt](daunt) first seen on Amrou Kithkin and first named in Mystery Booster 2. See also [gives nimble](gives-nimble).

label: cycle-inv-c-nonc-kicker-spell
description: Common noncreature spells from Invasion with a colorless kicker cost.

label: prowess-like
description: Creatures that get bigger when you cast noncreature spells. For actual prowess, use kw:prowess. See also [prowess anthem](prowess-anthem).

label: hatebird
description: (Usually) 3 MV flying creatures that mirror the lower-costed [hatebears](hatebear).

label: afflict
description: An ability that makes defending players lose life for blocking. It exists primarily as a keyword although variants that mimic the mechanic exists.

label: synergy-color-each
description: Cards that have a scaling effect for each color on permanents or cards. See [synergy-color-every](synergy-color-every) for cards that care specifically about five-colored cards.

label: counterspell-bounce
description: Counterspells that instead "counter" by bouncing the spell.

label: removes-mm-counters
description: Remove -1/-1 counters from your creatures.

label: eponymous
description: Non-token cards with a name matching their subtypes.

label: multiplayer
description: Cards that interact with all of the players in the game. They might scale with the number of players or affect the turn order for example.

label: restock-sorcery
description: Effects that put a sorcery back in your library from the graveyard.

label: exile-self
description: Cards which exile themselves (from the battlefield, from the graveyard, from your hand, etc.)

label: triggers at cleanup step
description: Cards that trigger at the cleanup step, rather than what would usually be the end step.

label: cycle-mmq-ramosian-recruiter
description: A cycle of five Rebels from Mercadian Masques. Each one has the Rebel recruiting ability searching for converted mana costs from 2 to 6.

label: synergy-exiling
description: These effects care about cards being exiled (as in the action).

label: changeling
description: Cards that have all creature types in all zones.

label: crucible of worlds
description: Play lands from your graveyard.

label: synergy-low-power
description: Effects that care about you having creatures with power below some boundary value.

label: detain
description: Prevent a creature from attacking, blocking, or using it's activated abilities until one's next turn.

label: dolmen ability
description: Derived from the titular card, this ability prevents all combat damage that would be dealt to attacking creatures you control. Other conditions may apply.

label: mimic
description: Cards that can copy (mimic) the abilities of other cards.

label: group hug
description: Cards that can be used to benefit other players, including opponents, usually by giving them resources

label: tutor-land-island
description: Cards that tutor Island cards.

label: quick equip
description: Non-Equip abilities that attach equipment.

label: hunger reanimation
description: Creatures this one kills come back into play under your control.

label: instant-sorcery-dichotomous
description: Cards that care about instants and sorceries separately.

label: tutors by name
description: These cards tutor other cards by their name. For their tutor targets, see [tutored by name](tutored-by-name).

label: mixed subtypes
description: These cards have subtypes on the same type line that belong to different card types. (For example, Dryad is a creature subtype and Forest is a land subtype.)

label: tormenting voice
description: A family of two-card rummage spells.

label: crewless vehicle
description: Vehicles that don't have the Crew keyword.

label: mix-and-match
description: Two or more non-evergreen mechanics blended together on the same card.

label: upkeep cost
description: Cards that ask you to pay some kind of cost on your upkeep step.

label: berserk
description: A creature gets a power boost, but will die this turn.

label: multiple targets
description: These cards can target more than one object or player. Not mutually exclusive with [single target instant/sorcery](/tags/card/single-target-instant-sorcery).

label: enrage
description: An effect that triggers when the creature (or attached/enchanted creature) takes damage.

label: alliteration
description: Cards that alliterate, either properly or per Treacherous Trapezist.

label: unstoppable
description: Assign combat damage as though the creature weren't blocked. Also known as super-trample. See also [gives unstoppable](gives-unstoppable).

label: speech matters
description: Cards that care about talking (or the lack of it)

label: restores old rule
description: Cards that have an effect that effectively brings back a rule that was changed or removed

label: pre-game choice
description: Make a choice before the game begins, usually during deck construction.

label: type errata
description: Cards that were printed with a type-line that has since been updated. For cards whose token generation has changed, see [Token Errata](token-errata).

label: humble
description: Nerf a creature's stats and/or abilities as a form of removal. See also [shapechange](/tags/card/shapechange), [swap removal](swap-removal) and [deanimate](deanimate).

label: unique counters matter
description: Cards that care about specifically different types of counters.

label: purgatory
description: When your permanents die, they're stored in a holding area where they can come back after a delay.

label: you make the card
description: These cards came from community-driven "You Make the Card" events, where the Magic community works through multiple stages of voting to create a card.

label: game name
description: Cards that are named after game terms.

label: cycle-lea-slush-art
description: These cards were designed last-minute for Alpha and not playtested, and designed to use up leftover art. Read more here: [Alpha Top-Down cards  by WotC](https://magic.wizards.com/en/articles/archive/alpha-top-down-cards-2003-06-13)

label: alternate-cost-sacrifice
description: Cards that let you sacrifice permanents to play them for free/a reduced amount of mana

label: impulsive recursion
description: Sends cards to exile from the graveyard and you can cast them for a limited time. Similar to [Impulsive Draw](/tags/card/impulsive-draw), but from the graveyard, not the library. Not to be confused with [impulsive mill](impulsive-mill).

label: interrupt
description: This spell was an interrupt before Sixth Edition Rules introduced the stack.

label: exhaust
description: Abilities that you can only activate once.

label: attacking opponents matters
description: Cards that synergize with any attacker, as long as they're attacking an opponent of the card's controller.

label: type addition from none
description: Some creatures (Commonly artifact creatures) prior to the Grand Creature Type update were printed without Creature Types.

label: cycle-eld-r-m-two-color
description: The ten two-color rare or mythic rare gold cards found in ELD boosters.

label: power matters-individual
description: Effects which care about the power of one creature (or multiple creatures individually, as opposed to as a total).

label: bounceable aura
description: Auras you can bounce back to your hand.

label: just shuffle
description: Effects that shuffle the library without adding cards to it or removing cards from it.

label: namesake spell
description: Spells (or, mostly spells) with names that identify them with a specific named character.

label: cda-power
description: Creatures that have their power determined by a characteristic-defining ability.

label: animate vehicle
description: Cards that can turn other vehicles into creatures (other than by crewing them), permanently or temporarily. See also [animate artifact](/tags/card/animate-artifact).

label: tutor-creature-spirit
description: Cards that tutor Spirit cards.

label: tutor-legendary
description: Cards that tutor legendary cards.

label: battle cry
description: Whenever this attacks, each other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

label: silence
description: Prevent opponents from casting spells, and possibly also activate abilities.

label: enters in company
description: Creatures that come with more creatures attached on ETB without reanimating them.

label: animate self
description: Noncreatures that can become creatures. For creatures that can stop being creatures, see [deanimate self](deanimate-self).

label: cycle-nightscape-vertical
description: Black cycle of an Apprentice and Master from Invasion and a Familiar and Battlemage from Planeshift.

label: french vanilla walker
description: French vanilla creatures with only a landwalk ability.

label: tutor-multicolored
description: Cards that tutor multicolored cards.

label: nemesis-mega-cycle
description: A currently incomplete cycle of creatures printed in commander precons that provide a pseudo-targeted static ability that impacts a single opponent.

label: fake flying
description: Creatures without flying that can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach. See also [gives fake flying](gives-fake-flying).

label: tutor-instant
description: Cards that tutor instant cards.

label: repeatable surveil
description: See also: [repeatable scry](repeatable-scry).

label: repeatable token generator
description: Repeatable ways to create tokens

label: pinger
description: Effects that deal just 1-2 damage repeatedly.

label: fog
description: Effects that can prevent all or most of the damage from an entire combat, similar to the card Fog. See also [pseudo-fog](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/pseudo-fog).

label: card advantage
description: Things that give you access to more cards.  (The technical meaning of card advantage can be much broader than this, but this is what we're using here.)

label: digital-only mechanics
description: Cards with mechanics designed for the digital environment of Magic Arena. Includes Unknown and acorn cards with mechanics equivalent to an existing Arena one.

label: martyr
description: Creatures that sacrifice themselves for benefit.

label: confluence
description: Modal spells where you pick three options out of three, with the ability to choose a mode multiple times

label: cover card
description: Cards that are meant to cover face down cards.

label: repeatable sacrifice outlet
description: Repeatedly sacrifice stuff.

label: opponent land count matters
description: Specifically your opponent's land count, not [yours](land-count-matters).

label: pseudo-equipment
description: Before Equipment arrived in Mirrodin, WotC experimented with a number of effects that granted boosts that stuck but could be transferred.

label: hate-color-choose
description: Color hate where you choose a color to hate on.

label: un-forecast
description: Un-set cards that would later pave the way for black bordered mechanics

label: copy-self
description: Cards that make a copy of themselves

label: french vanilla equipment
description: Equipment that give a creature a stat change and/or a keyword with no other effects.

label: commander set booster cards
description: Card that debuted in a Commander Set but were only obtainable through boosters of the set it was released with.

label: minigame
description: Engages one or more other players in a bet or mind game (not necessarily explicitly).

label: freeze
description: A permanent doesn't untap during its next N untap steps. For effects that prevent untapping indefinitely, see [lockdown](lockdown).

label: type errata viashino
description: These were Viashino, now Lizards as of Modern Horizons 3.

label: cycle-m11-c-pw-signature
description: See also [cycle-m11-u-pw-signature](/tags/card/cycle-m11-u-pw-signature)

label: lose trigger
description: Cards that trigger when an opponent loses the game (as opposed a replacement effect for yourself).

label: cycle-mir-fetchland
description: Also known as "slow fetches", a cycle of lands from mirage that enter tapped and can be sacrificed to tutor a land that is one of two specific types to the battlefield

label: un-color
description: Colors that don't exist in black border, like gold or pink.

label: activated ability
description: Cards with activated abilities. Not for cards that only gain or give activated abilities.

label: arc lightning
description: Deals X damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.

label: phase manipulation
description: Cards that interact with the phases of a turn, usually by having players skip or gain additonal ones.

label: cast tax
description: When a spell is cast, something happens unless the player casting the spell pays a cost, usually mana.

label: flowstone
description: Abilities that grant +N/-N and/or -N/+N

label: punisher
description: Effects that give you a choice of two damnations.

label: seek-self
description: Cards that seek other copies of themselves.

label: extra untap
description: Cards that give you a way to untap things en masse, either with a new untap step or by an ability that untaps multiple things

label: tapper-permanent
description: Tap target permanent.

label: roll to visit
description: Cards that let you roll to visit your attractions (Outside of the regular main phase roll)

label: sleeping enchantment
description: Enchantments that permanently "wake up" and become creatures.

label: threshold
description: Cards that care about you having seven or more cards in your graveyard.

label: unnoted tracked information
description: Spells or abilities that require tracking events without explicitly noting them. See also [noted tracked information](noted-tracked-information).

label: tutor-creature-eldrazi
description: Cards that tutor Eldrazi cards.

label: spite damage
description: When you deal me damage, I deal you damage right back.

label: synergy-sacrifice-self
description: When *I* am sacrificed...

label: legacy
description: Effects that involve physical alteration or selection of the card itself before or during the game, usually with the implication of a permanent change of some sorts. Named after Legacy board games with this similar gimmick.

label: dilemma
description: Effects that give you two equally bad choices. Not to be confused with the action of "Dilemma".

label: reanimate-instant/sorcery
description: Effects that let you actually take an instant or sorcery card from a graveyard and put it onto the battlefield as a permanent, because Magic is a weird game.

label: hand size increase
description: Cards that increase the maximum amount of cards you can hold.

label: mana spent matters
description: Effects that care about the amount, type, and/or qualities of mana spent to do a thing.

label: plunder
description: Sacrifice something else to draw cards.

label: raid
description: Cards that have an upside if you attacked this turn.

label: tutor-artifact-legendary
description: Cards that tutor legendary artifact cards.

label: tutor-artifact-noncreature
description: Cards that tutor noncreature artifact cards.

label: x cost matters
description: Cards that specifically care about things with {X} in their mana cost.

label: bring your own crew
description: A vehicle (or spacecraft) that comes with a built-in pilot to crew (or station) it.

label: fire drake
description: A small family of drakes with once-only firebreathing abilities.

label: flicker-permanent
description: Flicker effects that work on all permanent types: artifact, creature, enchantment, land, planeswalker, and battle.

label: tapped matters-self
description: Permanents that care about being tapped. For cards that care about other tapped permanents, see [synergy-tapped](synergy-tapped). For cards that care about the action of tapping, see [uninspired](uninspired).

label: synergy-party
description: Clerics, Rogues, Warriors, and Wizards. Either cards that explicitly care for the party mechanic or couples them typally.

label: offcolor mana generation
description: Non-colorless cards that generate colored mana, but don't generate their own color of mana.

label: place sticker
description: All cards that put a sticker onto a card.

label: conjure-to-library
description: Cards that conjure cards into libraries.

label: wannabe dark confidant
description: Cards that riff off of Dark Confidant's iconic card advantage design.

label: transferrable aura
description: Auras that have a built-in way to move them between permanents.

label: nonstandard-bestow
description: Bestow creatures that, when attached to a creature, do something other than exactly providing a P/T boost equal to their P/T and their other abilities.

label: pseudo-cycling
description: Cards that discard themselves to achieve a similar function to cycling, but aren't cycling.

label: animate land
description: Cards that can turn other noncreature lands into creatures.

label: restock-any
description: Return any cards to your library from the graveyard, not caring about their types.

label: cycle-c16-u-monocolor
description: The only monocolored new cards at uncommon from C16.

label: tutor-color
description: Cards that tutor by color.

label: non mana ability mana
description: Abilities that produce mana, but aren't mana abilities (as defined by CR 605.1)

label: probe
description: Draw three cards, then discard two cards. Not to be confused with [compulsive research](compulsive-research) or [sift](sift).

label: animate planeswalker
description: Effects that turn planeswalkers into creatures.

label: clash-like
description: Cards that compare the mana values of multiple players' revealed cards

label: reanimate-cast
description: Cast a permanent spell from a graveyard.

label: seek-nonland
description: Seek for nonland cards.

label: repeatable scry
description: See also: [repeatable surveil](repeatable-surveil).

label: tutor-creature-dinosaur
description: Cards that tutor Dinosaur cards.

label: torment
description: A stock punisher effect where you force an opponent to choose between discarding, sacrificing, or losing life.

label: cycle-morphling
description: The "true" cycle of morphlings. See also [morphling](morphling) for similar cards.

label: toll
description: Generate resources from your opponent's actions without them being able to pay it off.

label: devour
description: Before a creature enters the battlefield, the player may sacrifice a number of permanents and the creature will enter with +1/+1 counters on it in relation to the number of permanents sacrificed.

label: gives pp counters to all
description: Put +1/+1 counters on all of your creatures.

label: creatureland
description: Lands that can animate themselves.

label: typal-share
description: Tribal effects that care about shared creature types.

label: counterspell-soft
description: A "soft counterspell" gives the other player a chance to buy off the counter, such as with a mana payment.

label: second spell matters
description: Cards that care when the player casting or controlling them casts their second spell for the turn.

label: draw
description: Spells and abilities that textually draw you cards. See also [pure draw](pure-draw).

label: landslow
description: Cards that prevent or otherwise limit the lands one can play

label: fetchland
description: Lands that sacrifice to tutor for other lands

label: combat timing restriction
description: Spells that can only be cast in combat.

label: old blocking deathtouch
description: Before the keyword was made evergreen in Magic 2010, deathtouch was sometimes a triggered ability based on blocking. See also [old damage deathtouch](old-damage-deathtouch).

label: counterspell-automatic
description: Cards that will automatically try to counter spells.

label: phyrexian mana cost
description: Cards where the casting cost includes phyrexian mana

label: synergy-surveil
description: Beneficial effects for the Surveil keyword.

label: cycle-tmc-teamup
description: A four-card cycle pairing each Ninja Turtle with one of the team's non-turtle allies.

label: counts as a type
description: Cards that used the deprecated "counts as a ..." language in their early prints.

label: self-discard matters
description: Cards that reward you for tossing your own hand into the graveyard. For cards that reward you for having a small hand, see [hellbent](hellbent) and [heckbent](heckbent).

label: exile-self-dfc-transform
description: DFCs that exile themselves as part of their transformation.

label: single-minded color hate
description: Cards that hate on a specific color (or colors), and do nothing else if that color isn't present.

label: morbid
description: Effects that care about at least one creature dying this turn.

label: counterspell-tuck
description: Counter a spell by putting it into its owner's library.

label: animate
description: Effects that turn things into creatures.

label: un type line
description: A card with a type only found in silver border or on Acorn cards.

label: cycle-ody-filterland
description: The cycle of filterlands originally debuting with just the ally color pairs in Odyssey and eventually completed in the Fallout commander decks.

label: cycle-un-psychographics
description: A supercycle of legendary "gamer" creatures that are named after different Psychographics of Magic Players.

label: enters-and-leaves-trigger-self
description: Permanents that have an effect that triggers when the permanent enters the battlefield or leaves the battlefield to any zone. Compare [life-and-death trigger](life-and-death-trigger-self).

label: donate rampant growth
description: Cards that allow you to ramp another player's mana by putting a land from their (or your) deck onto the battlefield. Compare [donate mana](donate-mana), which lets you add mana directly to their mana pool.

label: commander matters
description: Cards that care about commander mechanics. See child tags for the specific mechanics being engaged in.

label: mana dork
description: Creatures which can repeatedly generate mana

label: exile on resolution
description: Cards that exile themselves once they've finished all their effects. Commonly seen on extra turn cards.

label: pwdeck-tutor
description: Cards from Planeswalker Decks that tutor for the corresponding planeswalker.

label: life divider
description: Effects that make players lose fractions of their life total. See also [set life total](/tags/card/set-life-total) and [life doubler](/tags/card/life-doubler).

label: mana storage
description: Cards that can be used to store mana for later phases and/or turns. The storing methods are varied—many use counters to count stored mana, while others create tokens.

label: combat-neutral damage trigger
description: Creature abilities that trigger upon dealing any amount of damage, no matter if it was done in combat or not. Compare and contrast [saboteur](saboteur).

label: un-design
description: Features characteristic of and unique to the world of un-sets.

label: doctor who episode saga
description: A series of cards named after and mechanically referencing various doctor who episodes.

label: armoring
description: A toughness-pumping ability. See also [firebreathing] in red and [shade pump] in black.

label: rupture spire
description: Not only does this land enter tapped, it also requires you to tap another land when you play it.

label: restock-self
description: Cards that restock themselves.

label: mill-self
description: Cards that put cards from top of your own library to the graveyard. Check the tag "mill" for more.

label: seek
description: Put a random card from your library into another zone, usually your hand.

label: color spent matters
description: Spells and abilities that care about the color(s) of mana spent on them.

label: discount-self
description: Cards that have a way to reduce their own cost

label: typal coupling-distinct
description: Cards that care about different creature types in distinct ways.

label: paradox
description: Cards that care about casting spells from anywhere other than your hand.

label: cone spell
description: Based on Cone of Flame, these are cards with a theme of doing something three times with the values 1, 2, and 3.

label: hate-high-pt
description: Cards that specifically hate on cards with high power or toughness, typically at least 3-4.

label: guess
description: Effects that force you to guess at unknown information.

label: animate dead-like
description: Enchantments that put stuff on the battlefield and then become Auras enchanting those things.

label: playtest forecast
description: These playtest cards previewed mechanics seen within 2-3 years of release, meaning they were being worked on at the time!

label: pseudo-shroud
description: Prevents targeting from certain things from any player, including it's controller.

label: continuous effect from graveyard
description: Cards with continuous effects that work from inside the graveyard.

label: impulse
description: Look at the top N cards and put 1+ of them into your hand. Not to be confused with Red's pseudo-card-draw effect, [impulsive draw](/tags/card/impulsive-draw).

label: you matter
description: Cards that care about physical attributes of the player playing it

label: reanimate-creature
description: Return creature cards currently in the graveyard to the battlefield. Not to be confused with [cheat death](/tags/card/cheat-death), which interacts right as the creature dies.

label: unusual landwalk
description: Landwalk abilities that aren't for one of the five basic land types.

label: gives castable from exile
description: Cards that let you cast things from exile.

label: gives pp counters
description: Cards that give +1/+1 counters. For permanents that only give +1/+1 counters to themselves, see [gains pp counters](gains-pp-counters) (which may overlap for cards that can give counters to themselves as well as others).

label: burn-you
description: Sometimes your own cards hurt you the most.

label: wheel-symmetrical-optional
description: Wheel effects that give players a choice to actually go thru with the wheel effect or not.

label: hate-removal-sacrifice
description: Punish your opponent for trying to make you sacrifice your creatures. As a rule of thumb, to count, it should still work even if they make you sac your whole battlefield. See also [prevent sacrifice](prevent-sacrifice).

label: tutor-flash
description: Cards that tutor cards with flash.

label: tax attack
description: Cards that prevent players from attacking unless they pay a cost, usually mana

label: ransom
description: Cards that remove permanents unless a cost is paid.

label: extract
description: Exile cards from a library. They're just gone now.

label: cycle-tmc-m-turtle
description: The four monocolor face legends of the Turtle Team-Up decks.

label: vigor effect
description: Turn damage into +1/+1 counters.

label: slith ability
description: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to a player, it gets a +1/+1 counter.

label: synergy-solo-attack
description: Cards that care about attacking with only one creature

label: wish
description: Effects which allow you to bring in cards from outside the game.

label: lobotomy
description: Exile all cards of a particular name from a player's hand, library, and/or graveyard. See also [nevermore](/tags/card/nevermore), which forbids certain cards from being cast.

label: synergy-land-graveyard
description: Triggered Abilities that trigger whenever a land card hits the graveyard from anywhere (library, hand, battlefield etc)

label: poisonous
description: Makes, or is, a creature that poisons a player when it hits them.

label: frost armor
description: Spells cost additional mana to target stuff you control.

label: legendify
description: Effects that turn things legendary.

label: counter fuel-other
description: Use other permanents' counters as fuel.

label: infusion
description: If you gained life this turn, do a thing

label: flavor matters
description: Not to be confused with [flavor text matters](/tags/card/flavor-text-matters)

label: deprecated mechanics
description: Mechanics that have been deprecated by newer developments.

label: cda-toughness
description: Creatures whose toughness is determined via a characteristic-defining ability.

label: banish-graveyard
description: Exile one or more cards from graveyards as long as this remains in play. Often used as roundabout recursion.

label: castable from library
description: Cards you can cast or access from your library.

label: tutor
description: Cards that directly search for a card from your library, and sometimes other locations as well.

label: evasion

description: Cards that conjure cards into graveyards.

description: Abilities that can be activated from inside a graveyard.

label: tutor-creature-construct
description: Cards that tutor Construct cards.

description: This card's mana cost isn't found on any other card.

description: Damage can't be prevented, whether universally or for specific sources.

description: Cards that tutor basic Swamp land cards.

description: Cards that conjure duplicates instead of named cards or cards from spellbooks.

description: Skip a turn now in exchange for an extra turn later.

description: Each player puts stuff from their hand onto the battlefield.

label: green effect
description: Effects which are iconically green

description: Cards in Unstable that have multiple versions with the same collector number, same name, same mana cost, and same rules text, but different art and/or flavor text.

description: Cards that can return themselves from the graveyard to the hand.

label: snowfall
description: Cards that care about snow permanents entering the battlefield, not the weather condition.

label: maro
description: Cards with P/T equal to cards in hand. Named after the card Maro, a nickname for Mark Rosewater, the head designer for Magic: The Gathering.

description: Removal for one target specifically.  See also [sweeper](sweeper) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

label: tutor-land-plains
description: Cards that tutor Plains cards.

label: tutor-land
description: Cards that tutor land cards.

description: Cards that punish opponents for having few or no cards in hand. For cards that care about their controller's hand being empty, see [hellbent](hellbent) and [heckbent](heckbent).

description: These cards use a type of counter no other card does.

description: Effects that let you choose which planeswalker type they apply to.

label: conjure-named
description: Cards that conjure other cards by name.

description: Repeatable effects that, if an arbitrary amount of mana is dumped into them, will probably win you the game—for example, by drawing your whole deck, creating an arbitrarily large attacker, making an endless army of tokens, gaining infinite life, etc.

label: copy-spell
description: Make a copy of a spell on the stack.

label: repeatable creature tokens
description: Repeatable ways to create creature tokens

label: tutor-to-hand
description: Cards that tutor cards to the player's hand.

label: tutor-land-basic
description: Cards that tutor basic land cards.

label: conjure-random
description: Cards that conjure random cards.

label: remove-from-stack
description: Cards that remove spells from the stack without countering them.

label: affinity undergrowth
description: Affinity which cares about how many creatures are in your graveyard.

label: addendum
description: Instant-speed cards that do something extra if you played them during your main phase.

label: outlast mentor
description: Creatures with Outlast that boost your creatures that have counters on them.

label: landfall
description: Cards which reward you for playing lands.

label: token replacer
description: Cards that completely replace the tokens that will be created with other tokens.

label: unprinted token
description: Cards whose tokens haven't yet been printed in paper.

label: greed ability
description: Pay life and mana to draw cards.

label: gives flashback
description: Gives the textual flashback effect. For cards that let you cast others out of the graveyard in general, check [gives castable from graveyard](gives-castable-from-graveyard).

description: Hates out one or more creature types.

label: lure-limited
description: This creature must be blocked, but not necessarily by all creatures like a true lure.

description: Stuff is harder to target, but not impossible.

description: Cards that Scry but were either printed before the keyword was made, or before it was made deciduous in Magic Origins

description: Cards that say "non-type" where no other card does that for that type.

description: Cards that tutor snow land cards.

description: Creatures entering the battlefield causes you to gain N life.

description: Cards that require you to have a deck with specific attributes, or with an effect that requires you to have your deck be built with specific attributes.

label: overrun
description: Effects that grant trample and +P/+T

description: Cards that level up. No relation to the card Leveler.

description: You know how sets sometimes have broken cards? What if you could just delete that set from the game? A mechanism Wizards tried briefly and very firmly deprecated.

label: prevent sacrifice
description: Cards that prevent something from being sacrificed.

description: Effects that care about your things with mana value below some boundary value, usually 2 to 4.

description: Whenever you cast a spell targeting your permanent, something good happens.

description: Cards that exile other cards (or themselves) to use as reference marker for another effect.

description: CR 111.10 - Some effects instruct a player to create a predefined token.

label: indefinite effect
description: Effects that last forever, sometimes tracked, sometimes untracked.

description: Effects that care about your tapped permanents. For cards that care about something *becoming* tapped, see [uninspired](uninspired). For cards that care about being tapped themselves, see [tapped matters-self](tapped-matters-self).

label: storage land
description: Lands that can store up mana over time for later use.

label: combat ping
description: Cards that deal a small amount of damage during the combat step.

label: black effect
description: Effects which are iconically black.

description: Exile things as long as this permanent remains.

description: Cards that care about the exact number of colors a card has. See also [synergy-color-each](synergy-color-each).

description: Effects that check how many times they've resolved and do something different based on the result.

description: Cards that care about attacking. See also [attacking matters-self](attacking-matters-self) for cards that care about themselves attacking.

description: You and an opponent pick a creature you own, then they fight! (Or kiss, in the tunnel of love)

description: The cycle of ally-colored Swords of X and Y, begun in Modern Horizons.

label: burn any
description: Cards that burn any target: players, creatures, battles, or planeswalkers.

description: Land ramp that (potentially) nets two or more lands on your side of the battlefield

description: Interaction with other games you can see, have played, or will play.

label: tuck-outlet
description: Cards that let you put cards from your hand into your library.

label: portmanteau
description: Cards named with a portmanteau—a word that's a combination of two words.

description: Cards that share a name with achievements in the PC game Inscryption

description: Effects that care about speed directly, other than max speed.

description: Cards where you can sacrifice a creature and subtract its cost from the mana you pay

description: Cards that tutor Elf creature cards.

description: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty coupled Samurai and Warriors as card types that care about attacking alone.

label: creature engine
description: Playing your creatures gives you more cards.

description: Vertical cycle of the boons given to the witches on Eldraine by Talion

label: eat food
description: Cards that involve actual food, generally being eaten.

description: Creatures dying to this one make this one grow stronger. Coined by Maro: http://markrosewater.tumblr.com/post/178364542148

description: Slivers having abilities where more than one instance of the ability does provide additional benefit.

label: reanimate-from-any
description: Reanimate from any graveyard.

label: un-set mechanics
description: Card tags showing mechanics that (at least nowadays) only show up in un-sets.

description: Cards that dealt ½ damage or gained ½ life from Unhinged

label: wingman
description: Creatures with flying that give other creatures flying until end of turn when they attack.

description: Cards with flowstone and capacity to gain additional abilities or evasion.

description: Cards designed for Unknown events that care about what team you've chosen.

description: Gained the Phyrexian type, either after it was introduced with the big sweep at Modern Horizons 2 launch, or at a later date.

description: Cards that have synergy with the various face down mechanics in the game, such as manifest, morph, cloak, etc.

description: Cards that care about creature types, but not necessarily on a creature card—so they're compatible with the Kindred cards from Lorwyn, for example.

description: Abilities that can be activated from an object on the stack.

description: Auras that give stat changes and/or keywords with no other effects.

description: These cards create a copy of an Oracle card by name and cast it. (CR 707.13)

description: Cards that allow you to bypass mana costs. This could be by making the spell free or by setting a static cost that's independent of the original.

description: Prevent a creature from untapping for its next N untaps. For effects that prevent untapping indefinitely, see [lockdown](lockdown-creature).

label: tribute
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Tribute. Should be 1:1 with kw:tribute.

label: rummage
description: Discard a card, then draw a card. Mainly red. See also [loot](/tags/card/loot), the blue version, which draws then discards.

label: recycle
description: Sacrifice a thing to get another thing back from the graveyard.

label: tutor-creature-trample
description: Cards that tutor creature cards with trample.

label: bounce
description: Returning a permanent from the battlefield to its owner's hand

label: sunder
description: Remove everything attached to a permanent while possibly leaving the permanent behind. (Some of these taggings consider the permanent might be indestructible.)

label: drain creature
description: Hurt a creature and gain life to match.

label: land count matters
description: Specifically your land count, not [your opponent's](opponent-land-count-matters).

label: tutor-creature-vanilla
description: Cards that tutor for creature cards with no abilities.

label: color-choose-land
description: Lands that produce a mana of the color you specified when entering

label: counter preservation
description: When something else leaves, put its counters on another thing

label: tutor-creature-legendary
description: Cards that tutor legendary creature cards.

description: Cards that reveal the top card of your library and conditionally play it. See also [precognition engine](/tags/card/precognition-engine) for a more recent variant in this vein.

label: earthbend
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Earthbend. Should be 1:1 with kw:earthbend.

label: tutor-creature-embalm
description: Cards that tutor creature cards with embalm.

label: rhyming name
description: Cards whose names contain a rhyme, or come very close to it.

label: shakedown
description: Give me something nice, or my big thing might hit you.

label: life payment
description: Cards that cost life to use; not necessarily with the "pay" keyword.

label: draw matters
description: Effects that care about you drawing cards.

label: starting player matters
description: Cards that care about or interact with who is the starting player.

label: command
description: Modal spells where you pick two options out of four

description: Magic has a history of having pairs of knights oppose each other.

description: Creatures that are each of the four party classes.

description: These were ships, but now are the type that is crewing them (Not the keyword, you know what I mean)

description: Wheel effects that effect each player, sometimes with no choice on whether they want to or not.

description: Cards that reward you for making opponents discard cards from their hand. See also [hate empty hand](hate-empty-hand) for cards that throw a party in the aftermath.

description: Cards that make certain types of permanents enter the battlefield tapped.

description: Cards that respond to an empty library.

description: Cards that require paying an additional cost per additional target.

description: Cards that tutor monocolored cards.

description: Creatures that can stop being creatures. For noncreatures that may become creatures, see [animate self](animate-self).

description: Counterspells that can be cast right now with no mana cost (even if they might incur some alternate/later cost).

label: flicker
description: Exile a card then return it to the battlefield (now or soon).

description: Cards that change the targets of something on the stack.

description: Cards that care about sources you control dealing damage to you.

description: Cards that tutor creature cards with hexproof.

description: Spells that add mana.

description: Spells with additional costs. See CR 118.8.

description: Creatures that have two or more types that are considered to be a species, such as "Human" or "Elf"

description: Cards that care about creatures with equal power and toughness.

description: Cards where you can sacrifice an artifact and subtract its cost from the mana you pay

description: Effects that synergize with a specific planeswalker subtype.

description: These cards gained (Or re-gained in some cases) the egg type when it was reintroduced in Core set 2019

description: Sacrifice something else to deal N damage. See also [fling](/tags/card/fling), [bombard-self](bombard-self).

description: Magic has various flavors of "vanilla", referencing cards with no abilities or only keyword abilities. For vanilla creatures (those with no abilities) see [is:vanilla](https://scryfall.com/search?q=is%3Avanilla) in Scryfall search.

description: Effects which are iconically white.

description: Card names that include mathematical concepts.

description: Cards that can provide some amount of value without untapped lands.

description: These tokens had Phyrexian variants added in Modern Horizons 2 errata.

description: Effects that turn things into enchantments.

description: Cards that tutor nonland cards.

description: Effects that turn things into artifacts.

description: Cards that tutor creature cards with a certain power.

description: Consult effects that put the card you find onto the battlefield.

description: Activated abilities that can be activated from your hand.

description: Seek a creature card.

description: Cards that put -1/-1 counters on your stuff as a cost or requirement for other effects.

description: Cards that tutor Trap cards.

description: Counterspells that call out artifacts specifically.

description: Cards you can have more than the usual number of in your deck.

description: Activated abilities that remove tapped creatures.

description: Creatures deal damage to themselves.

description: Effects that sorta-proliferate some counters.

description: Cards that care about obtaining or having energy counters, but not by spending them.

description: Nine rare cards from Alpha considered to be the most powerful nine cards in the entire game.

label: cycle-m11-u-pw-signature
description: See also [cycle-m11-c-pw-signature](/tags/card/cycle-m11-c-pw-signature)

label: repeatable noncreature tokens
description: Repeatable ways to create noncreature tokens

description: Creatures attacking alone get +N/+N

description: Effects that last forever but aren't tracked by anything. For these purposes we're not counting ETB clones.

description: Players who have less get more.

description: Planeswalker cards that are just the full names of the character in question

description: The more creatures your opponent controls, the more these cards scale up to punish them for it.

description: Get cards in exchange for your life (damage causes loss of life).

description: Cards that tutor Kithkin cards.

description: Cards that in some way give you energy counters.

description: Cards with repeatable effects that you can dump a bunch of mana (at least 3) into each turn.

description: Cards that give -1/-1 counters.

description: Effects that return other cards from your graveyard to your hand.

description: No cards make these tokens, probably due to errata.

description: Cards that can block, but only in specific circumstances.

label: buttsaddle
description: Cards that saddle with toughness rather than power.

label: tutor-creature-assembly-worker
description: Cards that tutor Assembly-Worker creature cards.

label: tutor-land-basic-mountain
description: Cards that tutor basic Mountain land cards.

label: marauder
description: Enters and causes all players to sacrifice a creature.

description: Cards that tutor sorcery cards.

description: Cards that change the colour of things in any and every zone.

description: Lands that will enter the battlefield tapped or untapped depending on certain conditions.

description: These cards received errata before or immediately after their initial release.

description: These cards are tutored by another specifically by their name. For the cards that tutor them, see [tutors by name](tutors-by-name).

label: burn with set's mechanic
description: Burn spells that have the mechanic of the set they debuted in.

label: peek
description: Cards that give you access to hidden information (Yours or other players)

label: sol land
description: Lands that mimic the mana ability of Sol Ring: add two colorless mana.

label: drain life
description: Hurt your opponent and gain life to match.

label: buff mana
description: Mana that comes with additional benefits when spent.

label: thingfall
description: Abilities that trigger when something (other than itself) enters the battlefield

label: cycle-tsp-no-mana-cost-suspend
description: A cycle of older cards, but now with suspend. (And no mana cost, so you have to use suspend)

label: punny name
description: Names that are puns or otherwise a play on words

label: eminence
description: An ability that works either in the command zone or on the battlefield, introduced by the tribal leaders of Commander 2017.

label: y value
description: Cards that use "Y" for a value, usually  for "+X/+Y" effects on creatures.

label: copy-legendary
description: These cards can give you a copy of a legendary permanent you control that you can actually keep (instead of immediately sacrificing).

label: force draw
description: Force an opponent to draw cards, whether they like it or not. The lesser used mode on Ancestral Recall.

label: tutor-card
description: Cards that tutor any cards.

label: cycle-block-rtr-guildmage
description: The guildmage cycle from Return to Ravnica block. Each has two activated abilities corresponding to both of the guild's colors.

label: retaliate to damage
description: Effects that retaliate to damage inflicted upon you, by benefitting you or punishing the opponent.

label: discard-symmetrical
description: Force each player to discard cards without drawing back up. See also [wheel-symmetrical](wheel-symmetrical).

label: conjure-sorcery
description: Cards that conjure sorceries.

label: school name
description: Card names that include things you might find/do in schools.

label: hatebear
description: Creatures that are low-cost (2 MV or less) and have low-power/toughness with relevant effects that may disrupt an opponent's strategy. These are traditionally associated with white.

label: symmetrical
description: Cards that affect the whole battlefield/all players in symmetrical, equal manner.

label: trumpet blast
description: Instants that give +N/+0 to all your (attacking) creatures until end of turn.

label: tutor-creature-elemental
description: Cards that tutor Elemental cards.

label: discard to library
description: Put cards from the opponent's hand back into their library.

label: unearth
description: Compilation tag for the Unearth keyword. Should be 1:1 with "kw:unearth".

label: rack effect
description: Players get burned or lose life for having a small hand.

label: synergy-multicolor
description: Cards that care about you using multicolored cards.

label: non-integer
description: Card contains a non-integer value (any number that is not a whole number), whether it be in mana cost, rules text, P/T or elsewhere.

label: animate artifact
description: Cards that can turn other noncreature artifacts into creatures. See also [animate vehicle](/tags/card/animate-vehicle).

label: cycle-arch-charm
description: Multi-Set supercycle of cards that cost MMM

label: divvy
description: Cards that make you choose from two or more piles.

label: proto-finality
description: The effect of finality counters, before the counters existed.

label: giant growth
description: Combat tricks that give a creature +N/+N. See also [Enlarge](enlarge).

label: unique token
description: This token is created by only one card.

label: discard
description: Gets cards out of your opponent's hand and into their graveyard.

label: provoke lite
description: "That creature must block this one this combat if able." It's like Provoke, but without the untapping. Also similar to [lure](lure) and [lure-limited](lure-limited).

label: grind
description: Mill cards until N land cards are milled.

label: typal-choose
description: Choose a creature type with which to synergize.

label: x doesn't matter
description: Cards that don't explicitly care about the value of the {X} in their costs (usually because [mana spent matters](mana-spent-matters) in some other way).

label: buttfling
description: Fling, but using toughness for damage.

label: form
description: Cards with the intent of "transforming you" into something, usually involving various benefits and drawbacks.

label: boltland
description: Lands you can pay 3 life/take 3 damage to have them enter untapped.

label: cycle-blb-hybrid
description: A cycle of 2 colour hybrid creatures from Bloomburrow.

label: synergy-dice
description: Various effects that either make dice rolling better, or love when you [roll dice](dice-roll).

label: surveil
description: Cards that let you look at the top # cards of your library and put some into the graveyard.

label: greatest power matters
description: Cards that care about a player having the greatest power among creatures

label: titan immortality
description: These cards are shuffled into your library as they hit the graveyard.

label: opaline effect
description: Whenever your stuff becomes the target of a spell and/or ability, you draw a card.

label: tutor-land-forest
description: Cards that tutor Forest cards.

label: regrowth-artifact
description: Effects that put an artifact back in your hand from the graveyard.

label: type errata name self
description: These creatures used to just have Summon {CARDNAME} in their text box. Cf. [eponymous](eponymous).

label: power matters-total
description: Effects which care about the total power of some set of creatures.

label: exchange control
description: Here's my stuff, give me yours.

label: restock
description: Effects that return cards from the graveyard to the library. (Named in Maro's color pie 2017 article.)
